simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גַּחַם (H1514) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: גַּחַם (Gacham) means Gacham , a son of Nahor First listed occurrence: Gen 22 24.

definitions.full: H1514. Gacham גַּ֫חַם proper name, masculine ( flame ? ) Gen 22:24 a son of Nahor, brother of Abraham, by רְאוּמָה his concubine. גחן (compare Aramaic גְּחַן , Nasar. (Syriac PS) curve, bend ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to burn; flame;
